changes.title: Version 1.0.1
changes.summary: The definition of mean_months now says that sentences of 470 months or more, including life, count as 470 months, per the Commission's tables. Every figure is unchanged.

changes.title: Federal sentencing by district first published
changes.summary: U.S. Sentencing Commission counts of individuals sentenced in federal court, with prison rates and average sentence lengths, for the nation and 94 federal judicial districts, overall and by type of offense, fiscal years 2021 to 2025: 66,662 individuals sentenced in 2025, 92.3% to prison, average sentence 47.5 months.
